title: codec_dfu: full equivalence (pure + filesystem/FWPK + GX8002 UART-token paths), stock vs reconstructed C

method.emulator: Renode (g2 simulator), per-function equivalence harness: stock bodies execute in place from stock.app.bin, reconstructed C linked into ITCM; v=0 stock vs v=1 C compared on return value, memory, and semantic bus/stub traces.
method.harness: build/ws-hwdrivers-20261122/harness (autogen.py + harness.c + build2.sh), global-merge-off CFLAGS (-fno-common -mllvm -arm-global-merge=false), hard-float VFP, -ffp-contract=off.
method.compare: compareg.py trace+retval+memory diff, 12 fuzzed cases per function.
method.inputs: fuzzed args; fs/FWPK callees served by a new deterministic filesystem model (see harness_fidelity_fixes).

harness_fidelity_fixes: fs/FWPK model (additive K_FOPEN/K_FREAD/K_FSEEK/K_FCLOSE/K_FHEAPALLOC/K_FHEAPFREE stub kinds): file_open returns a fixed non-NULL handle and resets position+bump-heap; file_read serves a deterministic synthetic FWPK image (16B header magic=FWPK ver count=2, two 16B BOOT/FLASH records, blob bytes) from a tracked file position and returns count; file_seek sets position (origin 0/1); file_heap_allocate bump-allocates from 0x20270000 (safe gap, not RESULTS); file_close/file_heap_free no-op. Both variants take the identical path regardless of CRC outcome, so the model needs only deterministic bytes, not valid CRCs.
comment_addrs/suffix_addr RAM-resolve range widened to 0x20800000 so codec data globals (e.g. g2_codec_dfu_xfer_buffer @0x2035ee18) resolve.

GX8002 UART-token model (additive K_TICK/K_READBYTE/K_UARTSEND stub kinds): codec_tick_snapshot returns a per-variant-reset monotonic low word that jumps far past any token timeout (its uint64 high word is clobbered identically for both variants by the shared stub_common trampoline, so the 64-bit value compares equal); codec_read_byte_deadline returns 0 (no byte) -> deterministic timeout path; audio_uart_send_bytes logs sent-buffer content (<256B) to catch payload diffs; codec_porting_uart_set_baud returns 0. Both variants take the identical deterministic path.

RESULTS/trace buffer relocated for codec I/O units only (RESULTS_BASE=0x20380000, above the firmware global g2_codec_dfu_xfer_buffer 0x2035ee18..0x20360e18) via an overridable -DRESULTS in build2.sh; default stays 0x20300000 (full 5MB) so no prior unit regresses. The firmware global was NOT moved (per instruction). fs-heap also moved to 0x20368000 (out of the .data/.bss region).
codecio PRELOAD seeds g2_codec_dfu_boot_header (stage1_size=0x100, stage2_size=0x100) and boot/flash image pointers+sizes to bound the chunk send/flash loops; both variants use identical seeds.

Cooperating GX8002 responder (adds post-token-path coverage): codec_read_byte_deadline now serves a per-unit scripted token byte stream (-DUART_STREAM compile define; empty stream keeps the prior deterministic timeout path, no regression), and codec_uart_read answers 'M' for the bring-up sync loop. Streams match each function's protocol: Stage1 'FwfbOKOKGET', Stage2 'readyOboot>', FlashImage '~sta~~fin~~sta~~fin~[Result]:SUCC'. Each WaitForUartToken now returns 0 so the download/flash bodies run to completion for BOTH variants.
c_corrections: semantic_CodecLoadFirmwarePackage record-classification: reconstructed C used audio_uart_checksum_copy(&boot_info/&fw_info,&info,sizeof(info)) to stash each 16-byte FWPK record; stock emits no helper call there (its next trace event after the record read is the next file_read), i.e. stock does an inline struct copy. Harness caught the extra stub call (stock file_read id19 vs C audio_uart_checksum_copy id5) at trace index 31; fixed C to `boot_info = info;` / `fw_info = info;`. Real C divergence fixed (not masked); re-proved 12/12.
coverage_boundary: Both the deterministic timeout path (first token wait -> -1) AND the cooperative post-token path (all token waits succeed, bodies run to the end) are now proven equivalent for DownloadBootStage1/2 and FlashImage. SVC_CodecDfu/CheckAndUpgrade are proven on the timeout path (4/4); full SVC post-token integration additionally needs a crafted synthetic FWPK boot-header blob (so ReadBootHeader yields a small valid header) and is deferred. No input where C and stock diverge was suppressed.
